+Decisions:
+
+- D38 — Round 30 of 99 opens a comprehension pass after the Go-To-Market density pass (D30–D37) closed. The deck's most load-bearing architectural term, "the one-ninth gate," appears on roughly seventeen shown faces (S1 ladder, S1 strategy, S2 roadmap, S2 toprisks, S13 comm mitigation, S14 notes, S15 prio, S17 prio, S12 l0) yet is defined on no shown (hi) face — only S4's speaker note glosses it operationally ("fewer than 15 of the benchmark's 130 minutes," ≈ one-ninth of the baseline, D14) and the master's platform.rules carries "the one-ninth (11.1 %) gate." A first-time reader — investor, future customer, system thinker without analytics know-how — meets the term on the summary slide and must trust it. This round defines it once, at its first shown appearance (S1.oneline, the ladder), in plain words: "a function goes native only after it removes at least a ninth of the benchmark's baseline on its clock, a floor to qualify." It invents no number (a ninth is a fraction of a baseline the deck already carries, faithful to the master's 11.1 % and to S4's stop rule), moves no printed figure, date or law (the years 2027 / 2030 / 2525 stay), and keeps ai a superset of hi (the definition mirrors into oneline.ai, which retains its master-sentence tail). Anchored on the unique "absorb by the one-ninth gate (2030)" string (its two occurrences, hi and ai), so only the ladder segment changes. The shown S1.oneline cell grows to roughly 370 characters — under the kept financial-core (S3 Ramp 519) and single-argument (S5 problem 564) cells that laws 3 and 6 keep on the face — a bounded, one-time cost that makes every one of the term's ~17 later uses legible where the reader first meets it. This raises scalability (a 2525 or any-segment reader now resolves the core absorption mechanism), efficiency (comprehension without a note dive) and stability (the term now means one thing across the deck), at a negligible succinctness cost. The note-only fuller definitions (S14.notes, S16.counter) still serve the detail reader; the shown face now carries the floor. It supersedes nothing — it fills a gap the density pass left, and it is the first pass of a new class (make every shown term self-explaining) that later rounds can extend to any other jargon a cold reader cannot resolve.
